The '''Tusken King''' was the leader of a [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raider]] tribe, which resided on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] had infiltrated the tribe and stolen several ancient relics of the Tusken Raider culture. The [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tusken Raiders]] became furious and launched a raid on a nearby city of [[Mos Espa/Legends|Mos Espa]] seeking retribution. After a long and perilous [[Tusken Raider Invasion of Mos Espa|battle]], the local citizens and [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]] managed to drive the [[Tusken Raider/Legends|Tuskens]] away from the city. The Tusken King himself was killed in the battle. The Tusken King was also responsible for taking over the [[Tusken Bunker]] that had formerly been owned by the Empire.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The Tusken King was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:TA" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The Tusken King was added to the game as part of the [[W:c:swg:Tusken Army|"Tusken Army" Heroic Encounter]],<ref name="SWG:TA" /> introduced with the release of the [[W:c:swg:Chapter 7 Notes for Nov 1 2007|"Chapter 7" update]], on [[November 1]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67485&month=102007|text=Chapter 7: A Collection of Heroes}}</ref>
